description: A specified map \(f:M\to N\) is the underlying map of a structure embedding if and only if, at every finite parameter tuple, it preserves and reflects every atomic formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.embedding_iff_atomic_agreement.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  {N : Type w'} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N] (f : M → N) :
  (∃ e, ⇑e = f) ↔
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : L.Formula (Fin n)),
      FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsAtomic φ → ∀ (a : Fin n → M), φ.Realize a ↔ φ.Realize (f ∘ a)
